mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dart_stock_quantity ( corp_code, stock_code, business_year, report_code, stock_type, issued_stock_quantity, treasury_stock_quantity, distributed_stock_quantity, settlement_date, raw_json ) VALUES ( #{corpCode}, #{stockCode}, #{businessYear}, #{reportCode}, #{stockType}, #{issuedStockQuantity}, #{treasuryStockQuantity}, #{distributedStockQuantity}, #{settlementDate}, #{rawJson} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE corp_code = VALUES(corp_code), issued_stock_quantity = VALUES(issued_stock_quantity), treasury_stock_quantity = VALUES(treasury_stock_quantity), distributed_stock_quantity = VALUES(distributed_stock_quantity), settlement_date = VALUES(settlement_date), raw_json = VALUES(raw_json), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT id, corp_code, stock_code, business_year, report_code, stock_type, issued_stock_quantity, treasury_stock_quantity, distributed_stock_quantity, settlement_date, raw_json, created_at, updated_at FROM dart_stock_quantity WHERE stock_code = #{stockCode} ORDER BY business_year DESC, report_code DESC, CASE WHEN LOWER(stock_type) = 'common' THEN 0 WHEN stock_type LIKE '%보통%' THEN 0 WHEN stock_type LIKE '%합계%' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC, COALESCE(distributed_stock_quantity, issued_stock_quantity, 0) DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, corp_code, stock_code, business_year, report_code, stock_type, issued_stock_quantity, treasury_stock_quantity, distributed_stock_quantity, settlement_date, raw_json, created_at, updated_at FROM dart_stock_quantity WHERE stock_code = #{stockCode} ORDER BY business_year DESC, report_code DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
